home.title: Wasalni for Drivers
home.subtitle: Work on your own time, earn from your hometown.
home.feature1Body: Just 20% — the rest is yours. Full transparency on every trip.
home.feature2Body: Your wallet updates the moment a trip finishes. Withdraw on demand.

home.wakeLockNote: You'll need to keep the app open and your screen awake while driving. The web doesn't allow true background work the way a native app does.
